documents.title: Listing of Equity Shares of Baheti Recycling Industries Ltd

analysis.summary: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited reported a strong start for H1 FY27, with revenue growing by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores and PAT increasing by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores. Supported by increasing demand and capacity enhancements, management revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores while maintaining its margin trajectory. The company is expanding its Aluminium Wire Rod division in phases on existing owned land to reach a total capacity of 25,000 MT, representing an annual revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores. Additionally, Baheti received in-principle approval from NSE and BSE for its proposed migration from the SME platform to the Main Board. Baheti Recycling reported a successful FY26, surpassing its revenue guidance by 12% and achieving PAT growth over 15% higher than guided.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores while maintaining its margin trajectory.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we have revised our FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores, while maintaining our existing margin trajectory.

guidance.claim: The company surpassed its stated revenue guidance by 12% for FY26.
guidance.quote: FY26 has been a good year for us. We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: Management stated a revenue milestone target to exceed ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the upward revision in guidance is due to improved business visibility and opportunities across existing and upcoming product segments.
demand_outlook.quote: This upward revision is due to improved business visibility and the opportunities we see across our existing and upcoming product segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that confidence in growth prospects is supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements, and growing presence across key industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Over the past few quarters, our confidence in the Company's growth prospects has strengthened, supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements and a growing presence across key industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing owned land in two phases to reach a total capacity of 25,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: A key priority for us is the expansion of our Aluminium Wire Rod division, where we are expanding our capacity on our existing owned land in two phases. Over time, we intend to have a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT, representing a revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores annually.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred a capex of ₹10 crores per furnace to deploy new tilting rotary furnaces.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX of ₹10Cr. per furnace per paid incurred to strengthen our manufacturing capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT capacity with ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 scaling to 25,000 MT brings a revenue potential of ₹500 Crores a year from the division.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity has reached 38,000 MT with five more electric furnaces lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to run by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores, and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, while EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Captive solar plant operations will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces starting from Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, and Bajaj Auto to its direct OEM supply client list.
orders_capacity.quote: This year, we added some clients we are genuinely proud of - TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, Bajaj Auto- all of whom are now being supplied directly for their automotive requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy.
capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Real pressure exists on primary aluminium availability due to Middle East disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

management_commitments.claim: Management revised the FY28 revenue guidance upwards to ₹1,300+ crores while maintaining the existing margin trajectory.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we have revised our FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores, while maintaining our existing margin trajectory.

management_commitments.claim: Investing ₹20–25 Crores to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division.
management_commitments.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

management_commitments.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for commissioning.
management_commitments.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The captive solar plant should be running by the end of May 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
